citations.assessment: Rashi glosses the occupational term as the man in charge of the house, who makes the beer.
The text explicitly gives the omitted attribution, Rav Sheshet’s reaction, and the verse. The Gemara introduces the scriptural explanation through Rav Yehuda quoting Rav.
